title: Restricted Parallel V1 Runtime & Worker-Memory Scaling Characterization
purpose: characterize observed runtime of the qualified restricted parallel-v1 path relative to the serialized reference on one GitHub-hosted runner
characterize source-visible heavy worker-owned memory scaling with worker count
provide evidence for later runtime design without defining or qualifying a performance policy

timing_protocol.timed_region: only repeated complete 32-column runtime calls on preconstructed immutable fixtures; committed-state registries are freshly reconstructed outside the timed call for each repetition
timing_protocol.optimization: -O2 only for primary performance characterization; O0/O2 scientific identity is already a qualification property from F-MR20
timing_protocol.primary_observation_unit: paired block median runtime per complete 32-column call
reported_metrics: median microseconds per 32-column call by worker count
p95 microseconds per 32-column call by worker count
p05 and p95 observed ratio T1/Tw
timing_protocol.negative_values_or_slowdowns: retain; never clip or reinterpret as speedup

before_timing: worker 2 and worker 4 scientific results/state/mass bit-identical to worker 1 for the timed fixture
true overlap observed for worker counts 2 and 4
scientific_precondition.failure_policy: if any scientific precondition fails, do not publish timing characterization

memory_protocol.method: source-bound payload characterization, not RSS measurement
memory_protocol.persistent_per_column: no new heavy solver/workspace state relative to F-MR20 qualification
worker_owned: reference Richards workspace reachable through backend/model
A23BU worker execution context and solver scratch
report: which heavy objects scale with workers
which data scale with logical columns
source-visible array payload formulas where exact extents can be established

hard_nonclaims: performance qualification for physics outside the exact F-MR20 V1 scope

open: persist raw and summary timing evidence
